title: Like hard shingles
text: Like hard shingles. These are very odd. Part of this was my mistake, as I thought I was ordering regular dish cloths. I bought them for the designs on them. They are very small. They have a hard, shingle-like feel to them. The pics shown are from the first wash and dry. I will not be using these for my dishes because of the size and the texture, they'll go in the ragbag.
